A pointwise eigen-equation valid on every full p-adic shell yields a precise full-space ground-state identity for arbitrary nonradial complex Bruhat--Schwartz functions, proving both the sharp constant and unique radial minimizer. Taylor analysis gives the shifted-width O(M^-4) expansion. The bundled standard-library checker passes 858 finite diagnostics; analytic lemmas, not those finite checks, carry the universal claims.

value.rationale: Finite-annulus improvements to the globally sharp p-adic Hardy inequality are natural because the motivating source constructs annular minimizing sequences. An earlier radial estimate left its finite-width best constant and nonradial coverage open. The result supplies the exact optimal constant and the complete equality space for all angular modes at every width, plus a positive integral stability decomposition and a sharp width coefficient; these materially sharpen quantitative coercivity, rather than repackage the known Toeplitz spectrum alone.
